_readme: General federal sources of the site. State figures live in src/data/<topic>/ with the official URL each was read on (built from research/ by scripts/build-data.py). Never type a figure in a page.

usc667.label: 42 U.S.C. § 667: every state must set child support guidelines and review them every four years

cfr30256.label: 45 CFR § 302.56: guidelines for setting child support orders (rebuttable presumption, low-income adjustment, review)

irs452.label: IRS Topic no. 452, Alimony and separate maintenance (divorce or separation instruments executed after 2018)

irs504.label: IRS Publication 504, Divorced or Separated Individuals

irs525.label: IRS Publication 525, Taxable and Nontaxable Income (workers' compensation is not taxable)

ccpa1673.label: 15 U.S.C. § 1673: limits on wage garnishment, including 50 to 65% of disposable earnings for support orders

acfCss.label: Office of Child Support Services (Administration for Children and Families, HHS)

irs559.label: IRS Publication 559, Survivors, Executors, and Administrators
